title: Installation: Docker Desktop on Windows, Mac and Linux

videos.script: Most people meet Docker on a laptop, through Docker Desktop. This lesson is about what that application really is, because it explains half the surprises of the first week. {{vm}} Desktop is a Linux virtual machine with Docker inside. Your containers run in that VM, not on Windows and not on the Mac. The docker command stays on your side, and sends each request in. {{install}} Installing it is three steps on every system. What changes is the step that fails: virtualisation switched off on Windows, the wrong installer on a Mac. {{checks}} Then four checks. Two halves answer docker version. Hello world runs. The context says which engine you are talking to. And docker info says how big the VM is, which is the real limit on your containers. {{error}} Last, the error you will see first, and what it means: the command is fine, and the engine is not there.
